recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖：紅色族群在 CD117 vs CD25 圖上呈 CD117 強陽性且 CD25 陽性（占 18%），在 CD25 vs CD2 圖上也表現 CD2，即 CD117bright/CD25+/CD2+ 的異常肥大細胞表型。
features: Left plot (SSC vs CD45): red-gated events show intermediate-to-high side scatter and CD45 positivity overlapping the granulocyte region
Middle plot (CD117 vs CD25): a discrete CD117-bright population coexpressing CD25 accounts for 18% of events
Right plot (CD25 vs CD2): the same red population shows CD2 expression (circled) above the negative blue background
Blue background events are CD117-negative, CD25-negative, CD2-negative
Immunophenotype CD117bright/CD25+/CD2+ indicates aberrant (neoplastic) mast cells
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis displays three dot plots. Gated red events have intermediate to high side scatter with CD45 expression, and on the CD117 versus CD25 plot form a distinct CD117-bright population coexpressing CD25 that represents 18% of analyzed events. The same population expresses CD2 on the CD25 versus CD2 plot, whereas background events are negative for all three markers. Aberrant CD25 and CD2 expression on CD117-bright cells fulfills a minor WHO criterion for systemic mastocytosis, and the high proportion of mast cells is consistent with mast cell leukemia in the appropriate morphologic context.

ddx.vs: Normal mast cells are CD117-bright but CD25-negative and CD2-negative and usually constitute <0.1% of marrow events.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD117 expression
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are CD117 dim-to-moderate with low side scatter and CD34/HLA-DR expression, not CD117-bright with high side scatter.

ddx.dx: CD25+ T-cell or hairy cell leukemia populations
ddx.vs: These CD25+ cells are CD117-negative and express CD3 or CD19/CD103/CD11c respectively.
